scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan Yojana: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme
other_conditions: Student must be enrolled in professional/technical courses offered by NAAC accredited institutions, NBA accredited programmes, Institutions of National Importance or Centrally Funded Technical Institutions (CFTIs)
Eligibility is limited to one loan per student for either undergraduate or postgraduate degree courses, including integrated courses
Students receiving any other Central or State Government scholarship or fee reimbursement are not eligible
Interest subsidy is not available if the student discontinues the course unless the discontinuation is due to medical grounds with requisite documentation
The loan must be taken under the IBA Model Education Loan Scheme
benefits_summary: Provides a full interest subsidy on education loans up to ₹10 lakhs for eligible students from economically weaker sections during the moratorium period.
